# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Late teens to early twenties
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is described as a fat, round-faced, slow-moving young man. He has a broad, wholesome face and a somewhat clumsy, heavy-set posture. His appearance reflects his sturdy and unpretentious country background.

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, good-natured, and slow-witted. He lacks eloquence and initiative, often relying on his sisters to speak or act on his behalf in social situations. Though kind-hearted and dependable in his work, he is exceptionally bashful, particularly around girls.

## Traits

- Shy and timid
- Good-natured
- Slow-witted
- Taciturn

## Abilities

- Farming and manual labor

## Goals

- To marry Anne Shirley

## History

Billy Andrews grows up in Avonlea alongside Anne Shirley and her circle of friends. During his youth, he works on his family's farm and attends local social gatherings, though he rarely takes center stage due to his bashful nature. When he decides he wants to marry Anne Shirley, he lacks the courage to propose to her himself. Instead, he asks his sister, Jane Andrews, to convey his marriage proposal to Anne on his behalf. Anne promptly rejects the proposal, much to Billy's eventual relief, and he quickly moves on from the disappointment without lingering hard feelings.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the prominent Andrews family
- Brother to Jane, Prissy, and Nettie Andrews

## Affiliations

- The Andrews Family — Son and brother
- Avonlea Debating Club — Member
